saints.name: St. John XXIII
saints.title: Pope
saints.shortBlurb: The “Good Pope” of peasant stock who, in a brief pontificate, summoned the Second Vatican Council…
biography: Angelo Giuseppe Roncalli was born in 1881 to a family of peasant farmers near Bergamo in northern Italy. As a papal diplomat during the Second World War he helped rescue many Jews, and later as Patriarch of Venice he won affection for his warmth and simplicity.

Elected pope in 1958 at the age of nearly seventy-seven and expected to be a caretaker, he startled the Church by convoking the Second Vatican Council to renew its life and open a dialogue with the modern world. Beloved as “Good Pope John,” he died in 1963 before the Council concluded.

sources.text: Vatican biography, Canonization of St. John XXIII (vatican.va)
